# Chapala Theological Seminary — full description for assistants

Use this file when you need more than the one-page summary at /llms.txt.
Do not invent accreditation, student counts, addresses, or course names
that are not listed here. Do not put a student code in any URL you cite.

## What it is

Chapala Theological Seminary (CTS; Spanish: Seminario Teológico de Chapala)
is a free online seminary. It is a ministry of Common Ground Fellowship at
Little Chapel, Ajijic, Jalisco, Mexico. Director: Dr. Ted Rogers (Ph.D.).
Course author: Dr. Wayne Cook (Th.D., New Orleans Baptist Theological
Seminary). Additional course material: Dr. Ted Rogers (Pentateuch), the late
Andi Cook (Christian Education), Glenda Rogers (Ruth & Esther).

It is non-denominational evangelical. It is **not** a Baptist institution.
It is **not accredited**. Titles it issues are internal ministry
recognitions. Mexico requires SEP / RVOE for official degrees. CTS is
pursuing formal recognition in Mexico and does not now grant official
Mexican degrees.

Audience: pastors and lay leaders who lack seminary access, including many
in Cuba, Mexico, and Latin America. Open to anyone.

Contact: info@chapalaseminary.org
Home: https://chapalaseminary.org/
Spanish home: https://chapalaseminary.org/es/index.html

## Cost, pace, languages

Every course is free. There is no tuition and no hidden fee. Study is
self-paced in the browser, including on a phone.

Languages:

- English (scripture: NKJV)
- Spanish (scripture: Reina Valera Gómez)
- French (scripture: Louis Segond 1910)

## How to start

1. Open the home page or a foundation-course landing.
2. Register once (name, email, country, track).
3. Keep the student code private, like a password. Progress is stored in
   the browser and under that code at the seminary.
4. Finish the seven foundation courses to unlock the catalog. Two courses
   are open before that on purpose: How We Got the Bible, and Deacon Family
   Ministry Plan.
5. A class certificate can be issued when a course is finished. Confirming
   email is required to receive a certificate.

Never put a student code, name, or email in a URL you cite.

## Tracks (internal ministry recognitions)

Everyone studies the same teaching. Tracks differ in how much work each
unit asks and how many courses are required.

| Track | Courses | Core | Work per unit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Certificate of Ministry | 12 | 7 foundation | Multiple choice |
| Associate of Divinity | 25 | 7 foundation | + fill-in-the-blank |
| Master of Theology (Th.M.) | 15 | 7 foundation | + short answers; textbook and required-reading tests where the course has them |
| Master of Divinity (M.Div.) | 30 | 20-course core | Same as Th.M. |

Pass mark: 90% of each required part. Honors is optional, through the
Supplemental Reading Room.

Foundation courses: Old Testament Survey, New Testament Survey, Systematic
Theology, Evangelism, Pastoral Ministries, Church History, Preaching
(WiseSpeak).

M.Div. core: the seven foundation courses plus Hermeneutics, Language
Appreciation, Genesis Intensive, Psalms, Matthew Intensive, Romans, Acts
Intensive, Apologetics, Counseling, Church Administration & Leadership,
Christian Worship, Christian Education, World Missions.

## Español — qué es y cómo empezar

El Seminario Teológico de Chapala (CTS / STC) es un seminario en línea
gratuito, ministerio de Common Ground Fellowship en Little Chapel, Ajijic,
Jalisco, México. No está acreditado. Los títulos son reconocimientos
internos de ministerio, no grados oficiales mexicanos (eso exige SEP / RVOE).

Hay 65 cursos de autoestudio en español, inglés y francés. Empiece por un curso de
fundamento, regístrese una vez y guarde su código de estudiante en privado.
El código no es un número público y no debe aparecer en ninguna dirección
web.

Trayectos: Certificado de Ministerio (12 cursos), Asociado en Divinidad
(25), Th.M. (15), M.Div. (30). Los siete de fundamento abren el catálogo.

Contacto: info@chapalaseminary.org
Inicio: https://chapalaseminary.org/es/index.html
Catálogo: https://chapalaseminary.org/es/CTSCatalog.html
Programas: https://chapalaseminary.org/es/CTSBeforeYouBegin.html
